# Interview Realtime Copilot

> Interview Realtime Copilot is an AI interview assistant for Mac: it transcribes and translates the interviewer live, detects each question and hints an answer from your own resume. Free plan.

Key facts:
- Category: AI interview assistant / interview copilot (中文：AI 面试助手、实时面试辅助).
- Platform: macOS 14.2 or later on Apple Silicon. Windows is planned.
- Live interviews: transcribes the interviewer, translates English and Chinese, detects each finished question, hints a short answer from the user's own resume and notes.
- Coding rounds: reads the problem from a screenshot and returns runnable code with complexity and edge cases.
- Practice: a spoken AI interviewer asks the questions extracted from the user's preparation notes.
- After each session: a question-by-question debrief and the recording.
- Privacy: documents, transcripts and recordings stay on the user's Mac; the window is excluded from screen sharing.
- Pricing: free plan; Pro £25/month or £169/year plus local tax.
- Site languages: English (https://copilot.xichiuk.com/) and Chinese (https://copilot.xichiuk.com/zh/).
- Support: linkyourfuture2026@outlook.com

## Product
- [Home](https://copilot.xichiuk.com/): overview, the problems it solves, frequently asked questions
- [Use cases](https://copilot.xichiuk.com/use-cases.html): Six interview moments the copilot handles: video interviews, interviewing in a second language, coding rounds, rehearsing prepared answers, getting stuck mid-answer, and debriefs.
- [Demo](https://copilot.xichiuk.com/demo.html): Watch a live interview question get transcribed, translated, recognised and answered in seconds — the cockpit you see during a real interview.
- [Pricing](https://copilot.xichiuk.com/pricing.html): Free plan with a monthly AI allowance; Pro is £25 a month or £169 a year with 20 times the allowance. Cancel anytime; local tax added at checkout.
- [Download](https://copilot.xichiuk.com/download.html): Download Interview Realtime Copilot for Mac (Apple Silicon, macOS 14.2 or later). Sign in with your website account and start a practice interview in minutes.

## Help Center
- [Help Center](https://copilot.xichiuk.com/docs/): What Interview Realtime Copilot does, the loop it runs on, and how to find your way around this guide.
- [Install and sign in](https://copilot.xichiuk.com/docs/install.html): Download the app, open it the first time, and sign in with your website account.
- [Set up permissions](https://copilot.xichiuk.com/docs/permissions.html): The microphone hears you; System Audio Recording hears the interviewer in your meeting app.
- [Plans and AI allowance](https://copilot.xichiuk.com/docs/plans.html): Every plan includes a monthly allowance of the realtime AI engine — nothing to set up.
- [Your first interview, end to end](https://copilot.xichiuk.com/docs/first-interview.html): From an empty app to a debrief in about fifteen minutes.
- [Goals](https://copilot.xichiuk.com/docs/goals.html): A goal is one role at one company; everything else hangs off it.
- [Resume and preparation notes](https://copilot.xichiuk.com/docs/materials.html): What to upload, what happens to it, and how prepared questions are found.
- [Spoken practice](https://copilot.xichiuk.com/docs/practice.html): A spoken AI interviewer asks your prepared questions, waits for you to finish and follows up.
- [Go Live](https://copilot.xichiuk.com/docs/go-live.html): Start a live session for a real interview on Zoom, Teams, Meet or any call app.
- [The cockpit and stealth](https://copilot.xichiuk.com/docs/cockpit.html): Keep the cockpit readable for you and invisible to everyone else.
- [Keyboard shortcuts](https://copilot.xichiuk.com/docs/shortcuts.html): Default shortcuts; change any of them in Settings → Shortcuts.
- [Coding, system design and screen help](https://copilot.xichiuk.com/docs/solve-screen.html): Let the copilot read the problem on your screen and explain a solution.
- [Debriefs and recordings](https://copilot.xichiuk.com/docs/debriefs.html): Every session is recorded on your Mac and reviewed question by question.
- [Privacy and your data](https://copilot.xichiuk.com/docs/privacy.html): What stays on your Mac and what is sent for processing.
- [Settings reference](https://copilot.xichiuk.com/docs/settings.html): The six sections of Settings.
- [Troubleshooting](https://copilot.xichiuk.com/docs/troubleshooting.html): Fixes for the problems people meet most often.
